title: CMOS Dynamic Range Lab
model: Simplified dual-conversion-gain sensor with ADC saturation
notes: A phenomenological model, not a measured sensor or transistor-level simulation.
Read noise is treated as a fixed input-referred value for both paths.
Each path saturates at the smaller of the photodiode full well and its ADC input range.
PRNU is optional and approximated as a signal-proportional RMS term.
The combined path switches from HCG to LCG at HCG saturation, without overlap calibration.
